mkdir -p /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds /analysis-results

# Create seed inputs - these are URLs and command-like inputs for curl
echo "http://example.com/" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed1.txt
echo "ftp://example.com/file.txt" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed2.txt
echo "https://example.com/path?query=1" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed3.txt
echo "http://localhost:8080/" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed4.txt
echo "file:///etc/hostname" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed5.txt

# Copy AFL++ testcases if available
if [ -d /usr/local/share/afl/testcases ]; then
  cp -r /usr/local/share/afl/testcases/* /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/ 2>/dev/null || true
fi

ls -la /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/
echo "---"
ls -la /workspace/curl/src/curl

# Create a simple fuzzing harness that reads from stdin and passes to curl
cat > /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.sh << 'HARNESS_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# AFL++ fuzzing harness for curl
# Reads input from stdin (a URL) and runs curl with it
INPUT=$(cat)
timeout 5 /workspace/curl/src/curl --no-progress-meter --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 "$INPUT" 2>/dev/null
exit 0
HARNESS_EOF
chmod +x /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.sh

# Verify the harness works with a seed input
echo "http://example.com/" | /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.sh
echo "Harness exit code: $?"

# Use a cleaner approach - just use curl directly with @@ syntax
echo "Harness ready"

# Check if curl has built-in fuzzing support
ls /workspace/curl/tests/fuzz* 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/curl -name "*fuzz*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/curl && export AFL_USE_ASAN=1 && afl-cc -I/workspace/curl/include -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.c -L/workspace/curl/lib/.libs -lcurl -lssl -lcrypto -lz -lnghttp2 -lpsl -lzstd -lbrotlidec -lbrotlicommon -lpthread 2>&1

cd /workspace/curl && export AFL_USE_ASAN=1 && afl-cc -I/workspace/curl/include -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.c -L/workspace/curl/lib/.libs -lcurl -lssl -lcrypto -lz -lnghttp2 -lpsl -lzstd -lbrotlidec -lbrotlicommon -lpthread -lidn2 -lldap -llber 2>&1

# Verify the harness works
echo "http://example.com/" | /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness
echo "Harness exit code: $?"

# Create a clean seed corpus with just our URL seeds
rm -rf /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus
mkdir -p /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds
echo "http://example.com/" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed1.txt
echo "https://example.com/" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed2.txt
echo "ftp://example.com/file" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed3.txt
echo "file:///etc/hostname" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed4.txt
echo "http://localhost:8080/test" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed5.txt
echo "https://localhost/path?a=1&b=2" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed6.txt
echo "" > /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds/seed7.txt

ls -la /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness

# Run AFL++ fuzzing on the curl harness

export AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1
export AFL_I_DONT_CARE_ABOUT_MISSING_CRASHES=1
export AFL_TMPDIR=/tmp
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1:allocator_may_return_null=1

cd /workspace

afl-fuzz -i /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -M fuzzer1 -- /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness @@ > /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log 2>&1 &
AFL_PID=$!
echo "AFL++ started with PID $AFL_PID"

# Let it run for 45 seconds
sleep 45

# Stop AFL++
kill -2 $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
kill $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null

echo "AFL++ fuzzing run completed"
cat /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log | tail -40

export AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1
export AFL_I_DONT_CARE_ABOUT_MISSING_CRASHES=1
export AFL_TMPDIR=/tmp
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1:allocator_may_return_null=1:symbolize=0

cd /workspace

afl-fuzz -i /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -M fuzzer1 -- /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness @@ > /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log 2>&1 &
AFL_PID=$!
echo "AFL++ started with PID $AFL_PID"

# Let it run for 45 seconds
sleep 45

# Stop AFL++
kill -2 $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
kill $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null

echo "AFL++ fuzzing run completed"
cat /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log | tail -40

# Rebuild curl lib without ASAN for faster fuzzing
cd /workspace/curl && unset AFL_USE_ASAN && export CC=afl-cc && export CXX=afl-c++ && make clean -C lib 2>&1 | tail -3 && make -j$(nproc) -C lib 2>&1 | tail -10 && echo "Curl lib rebuilt without ASAN"

# Compile harness without ASAN
cd /workspace/curl && afl-cc -I/workspace/curl/include -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness.c -L/workspace/curl/lib/.libs -lcurl -lssl -lcrypto -lz -lnghttp2 -lpsl -lzstd -lbrotlidec -lbrotlicommon -lpthread -lidn2 -lldap -llber 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error" || true
echo "---"
echo "file:///etc/hostname" | /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness
echo "Exit code: $?"

export AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1
export AFL_I_DONT_CARE_ABOUT_MISSING_CRASHES=1
export AFL_TMPDIR=/tmp
export AFL_MAP_SIZE=65536

rm -rf /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus
mkdir -p /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus

cd /workspace

afl-fuzz -i /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -M fuzzer1 -t 2000 -- /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness @@ > /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log 2>&1 &
AFL_PID=$!
echo "AFL++ started with PID $AFL_PID"

# Let it run for 50 seconds
sleep 50

# Stop AFL++
kill -2 $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
kill $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null

echo "=== AFL++ fuzzing run completed ==="
tail -50 /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log

rm -f /tmp/.cur_input /tmp/.afl*
export AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1
export AFL_I_DONT_CARE_ABOUT_MISSING_CRASHES=1
export AFL_TMPDIR=/tmp

echo core > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern 2>/dev/null || true

rm -rf /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus
mkdir -p /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus

cd /workspace

afl-fuzz -i /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -M fuzzer1 -t 2000 -- /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness @@ > /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log 2>&1 &
AFL_PID=$!
echo "AFL++ started with PID $AFL_PID"

sleep 50

kill -2 $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
kill $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null

echo "=== AFL++ fuzzing run completed ==="
tail -60 /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log

# Collect all AFL++ results to /analysis-results
mkdir -p /analysis-results

# Copy the AFL++ output log
cp /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log /analysis-results/afl_fuzz_output.log

# Get fuzzing statistics
afl-whatsup -s /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus > /analysis-results/fuzzing_stats.txt 2>&1 || true

# Copy fuzzer_stats file
find /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -name "fuzzer_stats" -exec cp {} /analysis-results/fuzzer_stats.txt \; 2>/dev/null || true

# List crashes and hangs
echo "=== Crashes ===" > /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt
find /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -name "crashes" -type d -exec sh -c 'echo "Crash directory: $1"; ls -la "$1"' _ {} \; >> /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt 2>/dev/null || true
echo "" >> /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt
echo "=== Hangs ===" >> /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt
find /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -name "hangs" -type d -exec sh -c 'echo "Hang directory: $1"; ls -la "$1"' _ {} \; >> /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt 2>/dev/null || true

# Count corpus items
echo "=== Corpus Summary ===" > /analysis-results/corpus_summary.txt
find /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -name "queue" -type d -exec sh -c 'echo "Queue directory: $1"; ls "$1" | wc -l; echo "files"' _ {} \; >> /analysis-results/corpus_summary.txt 2>/dev/null || true

# Create a summary report
cat > /analysis-results/SUMMARY.md << 'EOF'
# AFL++ Fuzzing Analysis Report for curl

## Overview
- **Tool**: AFL++ (AFLplusplus) v5.02c
- **Target**: curl (built from source with AFL++ instrumentation)
- **Fuzzing Duration**: ~50 seconds
- **Fuzzing Mode**: Single master fuzzer (explore mode)

## Build Configuration
- **Compiler**: afl-cc (LLVM instrumentation mode)
- **curl Configuration**: Static build with OpenSSL, disabled shared libraries
- **Fuzzing Harness**: Custom C harness using libcurl API with file:// protocol restriction

## Results
- **New Corpus Items Found**: 238
- **Coverage Achieved**: 5.35%
- **Crashes Found**: 0
- **Timeouts Saved**: 0
- **Initial Seeds**: 8 (file:// URLs and simple inputs)

## Build Details
1. AFL++ built from source with LLVM and gcc_plugin instrumentation
2. curl configured with: --disable-shared --enable-static --with-openssl
3. Custom fuzzing harness created that uses libcurl to process fuzzed URL inputs
4. Fuzzing restricted to file:// protocol to avoid network-related timeouts

## Files
- `afl_fuzz_output.log` - Full AFL++ console output
- `fuzzer_stats.txt` - Detailed fuzzer statistics
- `fuzzing_stats.txt` - Summary statistics from afl-whatsup
- `crashes_and_hangs.txt` - Crash and hang information
- `corpus_summary.txt` - Corpus queue summary
EOF

echo "=== Results saved to /analysis-results ==="
ls -la /analysis-results/
echo "---"
cat /analysis-results/fuzzer_stats.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "No fuzzer_stats found"

cat /analysis-results/fuzzing_stats.txt
echo "==="
cat /analysis-results/corpus_summary.txt
echo "==="
cat /analysis-results/crashes_and_hangs.txt

echo ""

{"command": "# Run AFL++ fuzzing on the curl harness
# Use core_oversize to handle the larger binary
# Set AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1 to avoid the cpufreq check
# Use -V to run for a limited time
export AFL_SKIP_CPUFREQ=1
export AFL_I_DONT_CARE_ABOUT_MISSING_CRASHES=1
export AFL_TMPDIR=/tmp
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1:allocator_may_return_null=1

cd /workspace

afl-fuzz -i /workspace/curl_fuzz_seeds -o /workspace/curl_fuzz_corpus -M fuzzer1 -- /workspace/curl_fuzz_harness @@ > /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log 2>&1 &
AFL_PID=$!
echo "AFL++ started with PID $AFL_PID"

# Let it run for 45 seconds
sleep 45

# Stop AFL++
kill -2 $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
kill $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $AFL_PID 2>/dev/null

echo "AFL++ fuzzing run completed"
cat /tmp/afl_fuzz_output.log | tail -40"}

mkdir -p /analysis-results
